prompt: Create a vertical close-up anime illustration of a small shy gothic cat-girl peeking out from between two hanging curtains covered in cute pastel character patterns. The character has a black cat-eared hood with tall pointed ears, short messy black hair with pale orange-tipped strands, very pale skin, flushed cheeks, and a tiny fang visible in a worried pout. Her eyes are mismatched: the left eye is an orange concentric spiral target, and the right eye is a dark button-like eye with a large orange X. She has watery tears pooled under both eyes and a sleepy, anxious expression. Her oversized black sleeves or mitten-like paws are held up in front of her mouth and chest, one paw showing exactly one orange adhesive bandage patch. Frame her tightly from head to upper body, centered in the narrow gap between the curtains, with the curtains blurred in the foreground on both sides. The curtain pattern should include many small cute doodle characters in cream, peach, orange, and muted blue, including ghosts, rabbits, skulls, stars, hearts, and candy shapes, but no readable text. Use a warm nostalgic color palette of orange, cream, muted teal-blue, charcoal black, and faded peach. Render in detailed Japanese manga/anime style with fine ink hatching, halftone grain, subtle paper texture, soft bloom, shallow depth of field, vintage film dust, and slightly overexposed warm lighting. Mood: cute, melancholic, sleepy, and eerie, like a bedtime gothic-kawaii snapshot. No watermark, no signature, no extra characters.
